arxiv-2104-02159.title: Identity and Posture Recognition in Smart Beds with Deep Multitask Learning
arxiv-2104-02159.creator: Vandad Davoodnia, Ali Etemad
arxiv-2104-02159.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vandad Davoodnia, Ali Etemad. Sleep posture analysis is widely used for clinical patient monitoring and sleep studies. Earlier research has revealed that sleep posture highly influences symptoms of diseases such as apnea and pressure ulcers. In this study, we propose a robust deep learning model capable of accurately detecting subjects and their sleeping postures using the publicly available data acquired from a commercial pressure mapping system. A combination of loss functions is used to discriminate subjects and their sleeping postures simultaneously.

arxiv-2212-07518.title: A jolt to the system: ram pressure on low-mass galaxies in simulations of the Local Group 2023 A jolt to the system: ram pressure on low-mass galaxies in simulations of the Local Group – 12
arxiv-2212-07518.creator: Jenna Samuel, Bhavya Pardasani, Andrew Wetzel, Isaiah Santistevan, Michael Boylan-Kolchin, Jorge Moreno, Claude-André Faucher-Giguère
arxiv-2212-07518.description: Abstract Low-mass galaxies are highly susceptible to environmental effects that can efficiently quench star formation. We explore the role of ram pressure in quenching low-mass galaxies ( M ∗ ∼ 10 5 − 9 ​ M ⊙ M_{*}\sim 10^{5-9}\,\rm{M}_{\odot} ) within 2 Mpc of Milky Way (MW) hosts using the FIRE-2 simulations.

arxiv-2303-14481.title: Diverse Embedding Expansion Network and Low-Light Cross-Modality Benchmark for Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification
arxiv-2303-14481.creator: Yukang Zhang, Hanzi Wang
arxiv-2303-14481.description: Abstract For the visible-infrared person re-identification (VIReID) task, one of the major challenges is the modality gaps between visible (VIS) and infrared (IR) images. However, the training samples are usually limited, while the modality gaps are too large, which leads that the existing methods cannot effectively mine diverse cross-modality clues.

arxiv-2410-19166.title: DCT-HistoTransformer: Efficient Lightweight Vision Transformer with DCT Integration for histopathological image analysis
arxiv-2410-19166.creator: Mahdi Cherakhloo, Mahtab Ranjbar, Mehdi Mohebbi, Bijan Vosoughi. Vahdat
arxiv-2410-19166.description: Abstract In recent years, the integration of advanced imaging techniques and deep learning methods has significantly advanced computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer detection and classification. Transformers, which have shown great promise in computer vision, are now being applied to medical image analysis.

arxiv-2501-03683.title: Multiparticle quantum walks for distinguishing hard graphs
arxiv-2501-03683.creator: Sachin Kasture, Shaheen Acheche, Loic Henriet, Louis-Paul Henry
arxiv-2501-03683.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sachin Kasture, Shaheen Acheche, Loic Henriet, Louis-Paul Henry. Quantum random walks have been shown to be powerful quantum algorithms for certain tasks on graphs like database searching, quantum simulations etc. In this work we focus on its applications for the graph isomorphism problem. In particular we look at how we can compare multi-particle quantum walks and well known classical WL tests and how quantum walks can be used to distinguish hard graphs like CFI graphs which k-WL tests cannot distinguish.

arxiv-2508-02876.title: The X-ray Variability and Luminosity Function of High Mass X-ray Binaries in the Dwarf Starburst Galaxy IC 10 Facilities: CXO astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , CIAO ( Fruscione et al. 2006 )
arxiv-2508-02876.creator: Breanna A. Binder, Rosalie Lazarus, Mina Thoresen, Silas Laycock, Sayantan Bhattacharya
arxiv-2508-02876.description: Abstract We present an analysis of ∼ \sim 235 ks of Chandra observations obtained over ∼ \sim 19 years of the nearby dwarf starburst galaxy IC 10 in order to study the X-ray variability and X-ray luminosity function (XLF) of its X-ray binary (XRB) population.

arxiv-2509-01678.title: Investigating the role of magnetic fields in the formation and evolution of striations in interstellar clouds with PRIMA
arxiv-2509-01678.creator: Raphael Skalidis, Konstantinos Tassis, Aris Tritsis, Paul F. Goldsmith
arxiv-2509-01678.description: Abstract Striations are diffuse, linear, quasi-periodic, and magnetized structures located in the outskirts of molecular clouds. These structures seem to play an important role during the earliest stages of star formation. Theoretical models suggest that magnetic fields play an important role in the formation of striations.

arxiv-2511-05408.title: Steering Language Models with Weight Arithmetic
arxiv-2511-05408.creator: Constanza Fierro, Fabien Roger
arxiv-2511-05408.description: Abstract Providing high-quality feedback to Large Language Models (LLMs) on a diverse training distribution can be difficult and expensive, and providing feedback only on a narrow distribution can result in unintended generalizations. To better leverage narrow training data, we propose contrastive weight steering , a simple post-training method that edits the model parameters using weight arithmetic.

pmc-11291900.title: Downregulation of 4-HNE and FOXO4 collaboratively promotes NSCLC cell migration and tumor growth
pmc-11291900.creator: Tianfei Zhong, Ying Li, Meng Jin, Jingqun Liu, Zhenyu Wu, Feiye Zhu, Lisha Zhao, Yongsheng Fan, Li Xu, Jinjun Ji
pmc-11291900.description: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is among the most prevalent cancers and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality globally. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) derived from NSCLC play a pivotal role in lung cancer progression. Our findings reveal a direct correlation between the abundance of EVs and the transfection efficiencies.

pmc-11500309.title: Dissipative Self-Assembly of Patchy Particles under Nonequilibrium Drive: A Computational Study
pmc-11500309.creator: Shubhadeep Nag, Gili Bisker
pmc-11500309.description: Inspired by biology and implemented using nanotechnology, the self-assembly of patchy particles has emerged as a pivotal mechanism for constructing complex structures that mimic natural systems with diverse functionalities. Here, we explore the dissipative self-assembly of patchy particles under nonequilibrium conditions, with the aim of overcoming the constraints imposed by equilibrium assembly.

pmc-11715349.title: Behavioral Reaction to Amyloid β Status Disclosure Among Research Participants with High‐AD Risk in Israel
pmc-11715349.creator: Sapir Golan, Michal S Beeri, Maya Zadok, Mery Ben‐Meir, Yael Rozen, Revital Shutsberg, Ariela Bem‐Moshe, Anthony Heymann, Yossi Azuri, Ithamar Ganmore, Ramit Ravona‐Springer, Chen Hoffmann, Liran Domachevsky, Orit H. Lesman‐Segev
pmc-11715349.description: BackgroundAmyloid beta (Aβ) deposition marks an early stage in the progression of Alzheimer's disease (AD), detectable in‐vivo years before symptoms emerge and targeted by recently FDA‐approved drugs. This has propelled advancements in understanding, measuring, and treating AD, paving the way for disease prevention in those at risk.

pmc-12547336.title: Correction: Identifying Contextual Factors and Strategies for Practice Facilitation in Primary Care Quality Improvement Using an Informatics-Driven Model: Framework Development and Mixed Methods Case Study
pmc-12547336.creator: Unknown
pmc-12547336.description: g author Jiancheng Ye’s rate of self-citation within the article’s reference list. Further investigation into this matter identified that numerous self-citations were added to the manuscript following acceptance of the article without adequate disclosure. All authors were contacted for a response regarding this matter. Author Theresa Walunas indicated that they were unaware of the addition of references post acceptance.

pmc-13013476.title: Case Report: Renal artery aneurysm rupture, axillary artery pseudoaneurysm, and catastrophic intraperitoneal hemorrhage caused by fibromuscular dysplasia with the involvement of multiple arterial beds
pmc-13013476.creator: Haihua Zhou, Shi Sheng, Yun You, Jian Wang
pmc-13013476.description: We report an unusual case of fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD) with multisite involvement into the intracranial, carotid, vertebral, internal mammary, visceral, renal, iliac, axillary, and upper extremity arteries in a 30-year-old woman. The patient presented with a spontaneous rupture of a renal artery aneurysm and an expanding axillary artery pseudoaneurysm.

pmc-13266386.title: Bilateral Serous Retinal Detachment in Severe Preeclampsia: A Report of Two Cases
pmc-13266386.creator: Latifa Oumaiouf, Hanane Mourouth, Meryem Essafti, Houssam Rebahi, Ahmed Rhassane El Adib
pmc-13266386.description: Serous retinal detachment (SRD) is an uncommon but vision-threatening manifestation of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, particularly in the context of severe preeclampsia and hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, and low platelet count (HELLP) syndrome. We report two cases of young primigravid women who developed bilateral SRD associated with HELLP syndrome.

pmc-13437221.title: Effect of allogenic demineralized dentin matrix vs. xenograft in maxillary sinus floor augmentation: A randomized split-mouth study
pmc-13437221.creator: Fatemeh Aghaziarati, Mohammad-Taghi Chitsazi, Leila Roshangar, Amirreza Babaloo, Elnaz Ziaei-Rad
pmc-13437221.description: Introduction: Maxillary sinus floor augmentation (MSFA) is commonly required in posterior maxillary atrophy. This study compared allogenic demineralized dentin matrix (ADDM) with a xenograft in MSFA.Methods: In this randomized split-mouth trial, nine patients underwent bilateral MSFA with ADDM on one side and a xenograft on the other.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general (1) Income and self-employment taxes No tax shall be imposed by subtitle A on income derived— (A) by a member of an Indian tribe directly or through a qualified Indian entity, or (B) by.
